hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');let d=process.cwd();for(;;){if(fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'.git'))){import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(p.join(d,'.codex/hooks/aidn-session-start.mjs')).href);break;}const up=p.dirname(d);if(up===d)throw Error('AIDN Git root not found');d=up;}"
